Observe backend and enabled capabilities
Native entities, receipts, research,
owned routes, jobs and launch evidence

div.style: color: rgb(75, 65, 45) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Session, finite facts and monotonic tick valid?
Enabled capabilities match retained ownership?

div.style: color: rgb(75, 65, 45) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Running or uncertain controller
has an unresolved pending action?

div.style: color: rgb(75, 65, 45) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(75, 65, 45) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Maintenance and storage
admit new work?

div.style: color: rgb(36, 59, 67) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Check prerequisite-ordered native predicates
Retain previously verified milestones
Defer goal changes during tracked background craft

div.style: color: rgb(75, 65, 45) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(67, 59, 83) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Persist completed checkpoint
Record verified completion and publish status

div.style: color: rgb(75, 65, 45) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(36, 59, 67) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Compile the effective capability-aware frontier
Bootstrap, serial or ready-work planner
Then apply committed-capital constraints

div.style: color: rgb(36, 59, 67) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Apply two-failure plan budget
Include connection failure attribution

div.style: color: rgb(75, 65, 45) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(89, 53, 63) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Mark blocked
Retain exact reason and failure history

div.style: color: rgb(36, 59, 67) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Ready-work: deduplicate and rank
Urgency, immediate need, estimated actor cost
Heuristics do not authorize execution

div.style: color: rgb(75, 65, 45) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(36, 59, 67) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Choose ready-work ranking first
Otherwise step count, then plan ID

div.style: color: rgb(36, 59, 67) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Commit selected plan and step index
Persist any capital or successor intent

div.style: color: rgb(67, 59, 83) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Observe again before dispatch
Recheck capability, maintenance and storage barriers

div.style: color: rgb(75, 65, 45) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(36, 59, 67) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;
color: rgb(75, 65, 45) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(75, 65, 45) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Next step allowed by native state,
ownership, locks and capital budget?

div.style: color: rgb(75, 65, 45) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Required carried materials available
for reservation?

div.style: color: rgb(36, 59, 67) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Persist pending = prepared BEFORE dispatch
Attempt identity, receipt, start tick and polls

div.style: color: rgb(36, 59, 67) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Execute one committed step
One dispatcher; no concurrent game mutations

div.style: color: rgb(75, 65, 45) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(84, 62, 48) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Proven local maintenance or storage rejection
Record rejected attempt; clear pending
Retain plan and reservations

div.style: color: rgb(84, 62, 48) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Persist ambiguous dispatch and error
Retain pending for reconciliation
Never blindly replay

div.style: color: rgb(36, 59, 67) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(67, 59, 83) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Observe after dispatch
Apply the composed execution barrier

div.style: color: rgb(75, 65, 45) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(75, 65, 45) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Background mode: accepted craft receipt
and paid-input evidence permit admission?

div.style: color: rgb(36, 59, 67) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Persist job and original attempt
Lock future outputs; release paid-input reservation
Independent actions remain serial

div.style: color: rgb(46, 72, 53) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Record verified attempt; release reservation
Clear pending, advance step
Reset stalled-decision count

div.style: color: rgb(75, 65, 45) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(36, 59, 67) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Clear completed plan
Refresh goal predicates when no background job

div.style: color: rgb(84, 62, 48) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Increment plan failure count
Release reservation and clear plan
Retain failures and paid construction

div.style: color: rgb(67, 59, 83) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Save checkpoint; append configured logs
Publish truthful status, decisions and evidence

div.style: color: rgb(36, 59, 67) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Wait configured interval within deadline
Ready-work acknowledged research waits may back off
No fixed deployed interval is assumed

div.style: color: rgb(89, 53, 63) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Unhandled controller, persistence
or backend failure

div.style: color: rgb(61, 78, 70) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Resume FLE hierarchical controller
Same checkpoint and session; remaining time only
Hybrid policy; Jev 1.13.0; configured features

div.style: color: rgb(61, 78, 70) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Fresh observation before new planning
Background extension also checks its retained job

div.style: color: rgb(61, 78, 70) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Controller checkpoint reports completed
Stop owned gameplay process
Supervisor records campaign completion

div.style: color: rgb(61, 78, 70) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Select from current feasible plans
Ready-work: deduplicate and rank evidence
Rebuild selection state each decision

div.style: color: rgb(61, 78, 70) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Committed native action type?
One controller dispatch at a time

div.style: color: rgb(61, 78, 70) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Factory adapter raised an error
Controller distinguishes exact preflight rejection
from a potentially partial mutation

div.style: color: rgb(61, 78, 70) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Adapter returned; success is not yet verified
Legacy FLE act may return an error string
Controller observes the required postcondition

div.style: color: rgb(61, 78, 70) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Every later observation checks job identity,
monotonic progress, deadline and earned output
Persist before allowing independent work

div.style: color: rgb(61, 78, 70) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Monitor checkpoint, owned process and fresh health
Default polling interval: 5 seconds

div.style: color: rgb(61, 78, 70) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Stop and reap owned gameplay process
Classify latest checkpoint and matching exit evidence
